tools.name: search_restaurant
tools.description: Look up a US restaurant by name and town from public map listings and, when found, the restaurant's own website menu. Never invents items or prices. Returns a placeToken needed to quote or place an order.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Fetch menu items and prices taken from the restaurant's own website only. If none are found, returns a note to type items. Does not invent dishes.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Validate an order and return the $5 call-placement fee, a Stripe checkout URL for the human, and x402 payment terms. Requires termsAccepted true and termsVersion 2026-11-17 (the human must have agreed). Does not charge and does not call the restaurant.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Does not place the call by itself. Returns how to pay the $5 fee (Stripe checkout URL for the human, or x402 USDC on Base) and the endpoints to call after payment. Paid placement is a separate HTTP POST after payment is confirmed.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Look up a paid order by its public reference (G77-YYYYMMDD-…). Returns outcome, ready time, total, and whether a $5 refund is due. Does not return customer phone or address.
